locator: can. 1364 §1 and can. 1365, doctrinam a Romano Pontifice vel a Concilio Oecumenico damnatam docet
interpretation: Can. 1364 §1: 'Apostata a fide, haereticus vel schismaticus in excommunicationem latae sententiae incurrit'. Can. 1365: 'Qui, praeter casum de quo in can. 1364, § 1, doctrinam a Romano Pontifice vel a Concilio Oecumenico damnatam docet ... et ab Apostolica Sede vel ab Ordinario admonitus non retractat, censura puniatur et privatione officii'. Read from the 2021 revision of Book VI on the page. The sanctions bear on teaching a condemned doctrine and on heresy; they say nothing about the grammar of the practice.
attribution: The passage states that a heretic incurs excommunication and that whoever teaches a doctrine condemned by the Roman Pontiff or an ecumenical council and does not retract after admonition is to be punished with a censure and deprivation of office, which is the premise.
